title: Fuel-burning appliances.
officialText:
Liquid combustion by-products of condensing appliances shall be collected and discharged to an
approved plumbing fixture or disposal area in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions. Condensate piping shall
be of approved corrosion-resistant material and shall not be smaller than the drain connection on the appliance. Such piping shall
maintain a minimum horizontal slope in the direction of discharge of not less than one-eighth unit vertical in 12 units horizontal (1-
percent slope).
